contentPattern.structure: one row per Q&A item: question label + rich-text answer body

suitableFor: FAQ pages with expandable question/answer pairs
any page needing collapsible details/summary sections

repoConventions.note: Plain block name (matches repo convention: cards/columns/hero/carousel/tabs — no variant suffixes). JS uses no external imports; this repo's vendored scripts/aem.js does not export fetchPlaceholders, and the native <details>/<summary> implementation needs none. Matches the Block Collection accordion content model (one row per item, 2 columns: label | body).
